title: Lakhiya v. State of Uttar Pradesh
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf and Prashant Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed of on licensee's statement; petitioner to pay PD dues within four weeks.
headnote: Writ for permanent disconnection and bill reduction disposed of on the licensee's statement that, if the petitioner paid the amount due for permanent disconnection, it would look into the matter, effect disconnection and reduce bills under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Petitioner directed to pay within four weeks.
facts: The petitioner, Lakhiya, filed a writ at the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh (Energy Department) and others concerning permanent disconnection of supply and outstanding electricity bills. Counsel for the respondents stated that if the petitioner paid the amount shown as due for permanent disconnection, the licensee would look into the matter, carry out the disconnection and reduce the bills under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court proceeded on that statement.

holding_units.holding: On the licensee's statement that payment of the amount due for permanent disconnection would be followed by consideration, permanent disconnection and bill reduction under clause 6.5, the Court directed the petitioner to pay that amount within four weeks and disposed of the writ without a merits grant or refusal.

not_decided.point: Quantum of dues for permanent disconnection and the actual 6.5 bill reduction
not_decided.note: Left to the licensee to look into after payment; no independent determination.
